preconditions.description: The number of silos n is between 2 and 2000, and the number of scout groups k is between 1 and n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= c[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))
preconditions.description: Each passage between silos i and j has a non-negative number of droids or is absent (c[i][j] = -1).

preconditions.expression: all(c[i][j] == c[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n))
preconditions.description: Passages are bidirectional, so c[i][j] equals c[j][i].
No silo has a passage to itself.

preconditions.expression: n >= 2 and k >= 1 and k <= n - 1
preconditions.description: The polygon structure guarantees that for any k-element set S, there exists exactly one silo adjacent to all silos in S.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(int(sum(sum(c[i][j] for i in S) for S in all_k_subsets) // len(all_k_subsets)))
postconditions.description: The output is the floor of the average danger over all possible k-element sets S, where the danger of S is the sum of droids on passages from each silo in S to the unique silo adjacent to S.

postconditions.expression: all_k_subsets == [set(S) for S in combinations(range(1, n+1), k)]
postconditions.description: all_k_subsets is the set of all possible k-element subsets of silos (1-indexed).

postconditions.expression: adjacent_silo(S) == {x for x in range(1, n+1) if all(c[x-1][i-1] != -1 for i in S)} and len(adjacent_silo(S)) == 1
postconditions.description: For each k-element set S, there is exactly one silo adjacent to all silos in S (1-indexed).

postconditions.expression: danger(S) == sum(c[adjacent_silo(S).pop()-1][i-1] for i in S)
postconditions.description: The danger of a set S is the sum of droids on passages from each silo in S to the unique adjacent silo.
